title: Candidate viewport QA configuration

branch.description: Exact reviewed candidate branch; CI refuses any other branch

packageRoot.description: Repository-relative package directory; no parent traversal

build.description: Only one relative .mjs script per node command, or npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; no shell evaluation

outputDirectory.description: Built directory relative to packageRoot; never . or source root

startPath.description: Local path only; no query string, fragment, credentials, or remote URL

description: Runtime validation additionally checks adapter/id identity, safe paths and candidate-specific identity. Does not accept JS snippets, browser flags, fixture files or state mutations.
